title: Edolobheni
description: Ten short, simple stories about life in the city: a fall in the street, a fire in a tall building, a local election, a concert in the dark, a child lost while shopping, a church wedding, a robbery, a rooftop garden, a writer's book and a zoo.

lessons.title: UNkanyiso esibhedlela
lessons.summary: Young Nkanyiso runs into the busy road and falls on his head; his mother Thuli takes him to hospital, where the doctor finds only small cuts and gives him medicine.
lessons.text:
UNkanyiso ungumfana omncane. Uhlala eThekwini nomama wakhe, uThuli. Namuhla akayi esikoleni, ngoba kuyiSonto. UNkanyiso udlala nezinye izingane ngaphandle kwendlu yabo.

Ngaphandle kwendlu kukhona umgwaqo omkhulu. Kunezimoto eziningi kulo mgwaqo. Umama wakhe uthi: "Nkanyiso, ungadlali emgwaqeni! Umgwaqo uyingozi."

Kodwa uNkanyiso uhamba ngokushesha emgwaqeni. Bese uyawa. Ikhanda lakhe lishaya phansi.

UNkanyiso uyakhala. UThuli uyamuzwa. Uya emgwaqeni ngokushesha. Ubheka ubuso bukaNkanyiso. Ubuso bakhe bunegazi. Igazi liphuma nasemlonyeni wakhe. UNkanyiso uthi: "Mama, ikhanda lami liyangiphatha! Futhi angikwazi ukuhamba ngonyawo lwami."

UThuli uthi: "Sizohamba esibhedlela namuhla!" Uthatha umfana wakhe, bese bahamba ngemoto baye esibhedlela.

Esibhedlela kunabantu abaningi. Balinda isikhathi eside. Bese owesifazane uyababiza. Ungudokotela. Ubheka ikhanda likaNkanyiso, ubuso bakhe, umlomo wakhe nonyawo lwakhe.

Owesifazane uthi: "Ikhanda lakhe liphilile. Igazi liphuma ebusweni nasemlonyeni kuphela. Unyawo lwakhe lunenkinga encane. Akukho nkinga enkulu."

Bese unika uThuli umuthi. Uthi: "Nika umfana wakho lo muthi kathathu ngosuku. Kumele ahlale ekhaya izinsuku ezimbili. Angahambi emgwaqeni."

UNkanyiso nomama wakhe babuya ekhaya. Ekhaya uThuli unika umfana wakhe umuthi. UThuli uthi: "Namuhla ngibone igazi ebusweni bakho. Uyingane yami, futhi ngifuna uphile. Hlala ekhaya." UNkanyiso uthi: "Mama, ngeke ngiphinde ngidlale emgwaqeni."

Imibuzo:
UNkanyiso udlala emgwaqeni na?
Kunjalo, udlala emgwaqeni, bese uyawa.
Ubuso bukaNkanyiso bunegazi na?
Kunjalo, ubuso bakhe bunegazi.
UThuli nomfana wakhe bayaphi?
Baya esibhedlela.
Owesifazane wesibhedlela unika uThuli umuthi na?
Kunjalo, umnika umuthi womfana wakhe.
Ikhanda likaNkanyiso liphilile na?
Kunjalo, ikhanda lakhe liphilile.

lessons.title: Umlilo esakhiweni
lessons.summary: Night guard Mzwandile sees a fire caused by bad wiring at the top of a tall Durban building; he gets the families out and helps an old woman, and everyone has escaped by dawn.
lessons.text:
UMzwandile usebenza ebusuku esakhiweni esikhulu eThekwini. Isakhiwo siphakeme kakhulu. Kunemindeni eminingi ehlala kuso. UMzwandile ubheka isakhiwo ubusuku bonke.

Ngolunye ubusuku, cishe ekuseni kakhulu, uMzwandile ubheka phezulu. Kukhona umlilo endlini ephezulu yesakhiwo! Ugesi omubi wenze umlilo.

Cishe bonke abantu besakhiwo balele. UMzwandile uyashesha. Ubiza abacimi bomlilo. Bese uya esakhiweni ngokushesha. Ushaya yonke iminyango. Uthi: "Phumani! Kukhona umlilo!"

Abantu bayaphuma ezindlini zabo. Abanye bathatha izingane zabo nezinto zabo. Abanye abathathi lutho: bayaphuma nje. Umama omdala akakwazi ukuhamba kahle. UMzwandile uyamsiza. Uphuma naye esakhiweni.

Umlilo uyakhula. Ushisa izindlu ezimbili eziphezulu. Abacimi bomlilo bayafika. Basebenza kanzima kakhulu. Ekugcineni umlilo uyaphela.

Ukusa kuyafika. Ekuseni abantu bonke bakhona ngaphandle kwesakhiwo. UMzwandile uyababala. Bonke bakhona. Bonke basindile! Umlilo awulethanga ukufa.

Umama omdala uthi kuMzwandile: "Wena usisindisile. Umlilo ushise izinto zethu, kodwa lokho akulutho. Siyaphila!"

UMzwandile uthi: "Ugesi ungaba yingozi enkulu. Umlilo ungashisa isakhiwo sonke. Kodwa namuhla akukho ukufa. Lokho kuhle kakhulu."

Imibuzo:
UMzwandile usebenza ebusuku na?
Kunjalo, usebenza ebusuku esakhiweni esikhulu.
Isakhiwo siphakeme na?
Kunjalo, siphakeme kakhulu.
Ugesi wenza umlilo na?
Kunjalo, ugesi omubi wenza umlilo.
Abantu basindile na?
Kunjalo, bonke basindile.
Umlilo ulethe ukufa na?
Cha, umlilo awulethanga ukufa.

lessons.title: Usuku lokhetho
lessons.summary: Nonhlanhla stands in a local election in Pietermaritzburg and asks for water, roads and peace; Ntuthuko finds his name on the voters' list and chooses her, and she wins.
lessons.text:
Namuhla kunokhetho eMgungundlovu. Abantu besifunda bazokhetha umuntu ozobahola.

UNonhlanhla ufuna ukuhola isifunda sakhe. Kule nkathi yokhetho uhamba nsuku zonke emigwaqeni yesifunda. Ukhuluma nabantu. Uyabakhuthaza: "Yizani okhethweni! Ningahlali ekhaya!"

Umqondo kaNonhlanhla ulula. Uthi: "Isifunda sethu sidinga amanzi amahle, imigwaqo emihle nokuthula."

Kudala kwaba nokulwa phakathi kwamaqembu amabili kulesi sifunda. Ngaleyo nkathi abantu abaningi abaphumanga ebusuku. UNonhlanhla uthi: "Ukulwa akusizi muntu. Sifuna ukuthula."

Ngosuku lokhetho uNtuthuko uya esikoleni sesifunda. Lapho kukhona ukhetho. Umsebenzi kahulumeni ubheka uhlu lwabantu besifunda. Uthola igama likaNtuthuko ohlwini. Uthi: "Igama lakho likhona ohlwini. Ungakhetha."

UNtuthuko ukhetha uNonhlanhla, ngoba uthanda umqondo wakhe. Abanye abantu bakhetha omunye umuntu. Lokho kulungile, ngoba wonke umuntu uyakhetha ngokwakhe. Usuku lonke abantu bayeza esikoleni. Akukho ukulwa. Kunokuthula.

Ebusuku umsebenzi kahulumeni uyazisa abantu bonke: "UNonhlanhla uphumelele okhethweni!"

UNonhlanhla uthi: "Ngiphumelele ngoba nina ningikhethile. Ngizokwenza lezo zinto: amanzi, imigwaqo nokuthula. Sidinga lezo zinto sonke. Futhi ngizonazisa njalo ngomsebenzi wami."

UNtuthuko uthi: "Lo muntu uzosikhuthaza sonke ukuba sisebenze kanzima. Umqondo wakhe muhle."

Imibuzo:
UNonhlanhla ufuna ukuhola isifunda sakhe na?
Kunjalo, ufuna ukuhola isifunda sakhe.
Umqondo kaNonhlanhla uthini?
Uthi isifunda sidinga amanzi, imigwaqo nokuthula.
Igama likaNtuthuko likhona ohlwini na?
Kunjalo, likhona ohlwini.
UNtuthuko ukhetha ubani?
Ukhetha uNonhlanhla.
UNonhlanhla uphumelele okhethweni na?
Kunjalo, uphumelele okhethweni.

lessons.title: Umculi eSoweto
lessons.summary: Palesa and Lethabo, who work in the same building, go to a big concert in Soweto; the power fails and the place goes dark, but the singer does not stop and goes on with her voice alone.
lessons.text:
UPalesa noLethabo basebenza esakhiweni esisodwa eSoweto. Bathanda umculo kakhulu. Namuhla umculi abamthandayo uzodlala umculo wakhe eSoweto, endaweni ebanzi yemidlalo.

Abantu bonke bayamazi lo mculi. Ugqoka okumnyama njalo, ngoba umbala awuthandayo mnyama. ULethabo naye uthanda umbala omnyama. UPalesa yena uthanda imibala eminingi.

Bafika endaweni yemidlalo. Indawo ibanzi kakhulu, kodwa namuhla igcwele abantu. Yonke indawo igcwele.

Ngaphambi komculo uPalesa noLethabo bayaxoxa. ULethabo uthi: "Umculo walo mculi muhle impela." UPalesa uthi: "Impela! Ungumculi omuhle kunabo bonke."

Umculi uyangena. Umculo uyaqala. Abantu bayawuthanda umculo.

Bese umculo uyayeka. Ugesi uphelile! Indawo yonke imnyama. Abantu bayabuza: "Ugesi uphelile na?"

Kodwa umculi akayeki. Wenza umculo ngomlomo wakhe kuphela, ngaphandle kogesi. Abantu bonke bayalalela.

Ngemuva kwesikhathi esincane ugesi uyabuya. Umculo uyaqhubeka.

Endleleni eya ekhaya uPalesa noLethabo bayaxoxa futhi. UPalesa uthi: "Lo mculi muhle impela. Ugesi uyekile, kodwa yena akayekanga umculo wakhe!" ULethabo uthi: "Kunjalo. Ugesi uphelile, kodwa umculo wakhe muhle kakhulu."

Imibuzo:
UPalesa noLethabo bathanda umculo na?
Kunjalo, bathanda umculo kakhulu.
Umculi uthanda umbala omnyama na?
Kunjalo, umbala awuthandayo mnyama.
Indawo yemidlalo igcwele abantu na?
Kunjalo, igcwele abantu.
Umculo uyayeka na?
Kunjalo, uyayeka ngoba ugesi uphelile.
Umculi uyayeka umculo wakhe na?
Cha, akayeki. Wenza umculo ngomlomo wakhe.

lessons.title: UMinenhle ulahlekile
lessons.summary: Minenhle, staying with her father in Johannesburg, gets lost in a big shopping place; a kind woman helps, a worker sends two people to find him, and father and daughter go home together.
lessons.text:
UMinenhle ungumntwana omncane waseMlazi. Ngalesi sikhathi uhlala nobaba wakhe eJohannesburg. Ubaba wakhe, uMduduzi, usebenza khona.

Ngolunye usuku uMinenhle uhamba noyise endaweni enkulu yokuthenga. Lapho kunabantu abaningi. UMinenhle ubuka izinto ezinhle isikhathi eside. Bese ubheka emuva. Uyise akekho!

UMinenhle uhamba lapha nalapha. Akamboni ubaba wakhe. Manje uyazi ukuthi ulahlekile. Uyesaba kakhulu, futhi uyakhala.

Owesifazane uyeza kuye. Akamazi uMinenhle. Yize kunjalo, uyamsiza. Uyabuza: "Mntwana, ulahlekile na?" UMinenhle uthi: "Kunjalo. Ngifuna ubaba wami."

Owesifazane uthi: "Ungesabi. Nami ngingumzali. Ubaba wakho unjani?"

UMinenhle uyakhumbula. Uthi: "Ungumuntu omude, futhi ugqoke okumnyama. Igama lakhe nguMduduzi."

Owesifazane uhamba noMinenhle baye kumsebenzi wendawo yokuthenga. Umsebenzi uyabuza futhi: "Ubaba wakho unjani?" Bese umsebenzi uthumela abantu ababili. Uthi: "Hambani nifune uMduduzi. Ungumuntu omude."

Ngemuva kwesikhathi esincane abantu ababili babuya noMduduzi. UMduduzi uhamba ngokushesha uya kuMinenhle. Uthi: "Minenhle! Ngikufune yonke indawo! Ngesabile ngempela."

UMinenhle uthi: "Nami ngesabile ngempela." Yize kunjalo, manje akesabi. Owesifazane uthi kuMduduzi: "Mzali, bamba isandla sengane yakho."

UMinenhle noyise babuyela ekhaya. Endleleni uMinenhle uthi kubaba wakhe: "Ngizokhumbula njalo: ngeke ngihambe ngedwa lapho."

Imibuzo:
UMinenhle uhamba noyise na?
Kunjalo, uhamba naye endaweni enkulu yokuthenga.
UMinenhle ulahlekile na?
Kunjalo, ulahlekile.
UMduduzi unjani?
Ungumuntu omude, futhi ugqoke okumnyama.
Umsebenzi uthumela abantu na?
Kunjalo, uthumela abantu ababili.
UMinenhle noyise babuyela ekhaya na?
Kunjalo, babuyela ekhaya.

lessons.title: Umshado webandla
lessons.summary: Nandipha and Mlungisi want a beautiful wedding but the costs in Durban are high; their church congregation cooks, makes the dress and serves, so they marry without wasting their money.
lessons.text:
UNandipha noMlungisi bahlala eThekwini. Banothando olukhulu. Bafisa umshado omuhle.

Kodwa izindleko zomshado ziningi kakhulu edolobheni. Ukudla, izingubo, imoto, indawo: konke kudinga imali. UMlungisi uthi: "Angifuni ukuchitha yonke imali yethu ngosuku olulodwa." UNandipha uthi: "Nami angifisi lokho. Sizocela ibandla lethu ukuthi lisisize."

Ibandla labo likhulu, futhi abantu balo banothando. Bathi: "Sizonisiza!" Abesifazane bebandla benza ukudla. Umama omdala webandla wenza ingubo yomshado kaNandipha. Ingubo inhle kakhulu. Amadoda ebandla ahlela indawo yomshado.

Ngosuku lomshado uMlungisi ulanda uNandipha ekhaya kubazali bakhe. Umlanda ngemoto kayise. Bese bahamba esontweni lebandla labo.

Ngemuva komshado izinceku ezintathu zinika abantu ukudla. Izinceku ziletha ukudla namanzi kubo bonke. Inceku endala ithi: "Lo mshado muhle kakhulu. Ugcwele uthando."

UNandipha noMlungisi bayabonga. Bathi: "Siyabonga kakhulu, bantu bebandla! Uthando lwenu lusisizile. Asichithanga imali yethu, futhi umshado wethu muhle."

Umama omdala webandla uthi: "Ningabongi thina kuphela. Bongani uNkulunkulu."

Ebusuku uNandipha uthi kuMlungisi: "Ngifisa ukuthi uthando lwethu luhlale njalo." UMlungisi uthi: "Nami ngifisa lokho."

Imibuzo:
UNandipha noMlungisi bafisa umshado na?
Kunjalo, bafisa umshado omuhle.
Izindleko zomshado ziningi na?
Kunjalo, ziningi kakhulu edolobheni.
Ubani owenza ingubo kaNandipha?
Umama omdala webandla wenza ingubo yakhe.
UMlungisi ulanda uNandipha na?
Kunjalo, umlanda ngemoto kayise.
Izinceku ziletha ukudla na?
Kunjalo, ziletha ukudla namanzi kubantu bonke.

lessons.title: Umsolwa
lessons.summary: A man attacks Nqobile in her small Pretoria eatery and takes the money; police officer Naledi recognises him on the camera pictures, gets permission to enter his house and he admits it.
lessons.text:
UNqobile unendawo encane yokudla ePitoli. Ngolunye ubusuku uvala umnyango wendawo yakhe. Indoda iyangena. Iyamhlasela. Ishaya uNqobile, ithatha imali, bese ihamba ngokushesha. UNqobile ubiza amaphoyisa.

Iphoyisa, uNaledi, liyafika. UNaledi uthi: "Ngitshele konke. Indoda ikuhlasele kanjani?" UNqobile uthi: "Yenze kanje: yavula umnyango, yeza kimi, yangishaya."

UNaledi uyabuza: "Lapha kukhona ubuchwepheshe obuthatha izithombe na?" UNqobile uthi: "Kunjalo. Ubuchwepheshe bami buthatha izithombe zabantu bonke abangenayo."

UNaledi ubheka izithombe. Esithombeni ubona ubuso bendoda. UNaledi uyayazi le ndoda. Ungumsolwa amaphoyisa amaziyo: wahlasela abantu kudala.

UNaledi ufuna ukungena endlini yomsolwa. Kodwa udinga imvume yomthetho. Uthola imvume ngosuku olulandelayo.

UNaledi uya endlini yomsolwa. UNaledi nomsolwa bayabhekana emnyango. Umsolwa uthi: "Angizange ngiye endaweni kaNqobile! Angizange ngihlasele muntu!"

Nokho, uNaledi umkhombisa isithombe. Uthi: "Bheka. Nguwe lo esithombeni." Umsolwa akakhulumi isikhathi eside. Bese uthi: "Kunjalo. Ngenze kanje ngoba ngidinga imali."

UNaledi uthi: "Ukuhlasela umuntu kubi kakhulu. Ngezinye izikhathi ukuhlasela kuba ukubulala. Lapha akukho ukubulala, nokho uNqobile uyesaba manje. Uzohamba nami."

Imibuzo:
Indoda ihlasela uNqobile na?
Kunjalo, iyamhlasela endaweni yakhe yokudla.
Kukhona ubuchwepheshe obuthatha izithombe na?
Kunjalo, buthatha izithombe zabantu bonke.
UNaledi uthola imvume na?
Kunjalo, uthola imvume yomthetho.
UNaledi nomsolwa bayabhekana na?
Kunjalo, bayabhekana emnyango.
Umsolwa uthini ekuqaleni?
Uthi: "Angizange ngihlasele muntu."

lessons.title: Insimu phezu kwesakhiwo
lessons.summary: Old Dudu farmed in the country and now lives in a Durban block; she plants food on the roof, waters it from a little spring, and soon sells her produce to the neighbours.
lessons.text:
UDudu ungumama omdala. Kudala wahlala emakhaya, futhi walima umhlaba omkhulu. Manje uhlala eThekwini nendodana yakhe. Bahlala phezulu esakhiweni esiphakeme, futhi akukho umhlaba wokulima.

UDudu uthi: "Ngifuna ukulima futhi." Ubheka phezu kwesakhiwo. Kukhona indawo enkulu lapho, futhi ilanga liyashisa khona usuku lonke.

UDudu uthatha izitsha ezinkulu. Ubeka umhlaba kuzo. Bese utshala izitshalo ezincane zokudla.

Izitshalo zidinga amanzi. Ngaphandle kwesakhiwo kukhona umthombo omncane wamanzi amahle. Nsuku zonke ekuseni uDudu uthatha amanzi emthonjeni. Uthela amanzi ezitshalweni. Uwathela kancane. "Ilanga liyashisa, ngakho izitshalo zidinga amanzi amaningi," kusho uDudu.

Izitshalo ziyakhula. Ngemuva kwenyanga izitshalo ziqinile futhi zinhle.

Abantu besakhiwo bayambona uDudu. Bayabuza: "Ungathengisa ukudla kwakho kithi?"

UDudu uyathengisa. Imali yakhe iyanda. Izitshalo nazo ziyanda, ngoba uDudu wengeza izitsha ezintsha njalo. Wengeza nezitshalo ezintsha. Manje kunezitshalo eziningi phezu kwesakhiwo. Indodana yakhe iyamsiza: nayo ithela amanzi ezitshalweni.

UDudu uthi: "Ngiyalima futhi! Ilanga lalapha liyafana nelanga lasemakhaya."

Imibuzo:
UDudu walima kudala na?
Kunjalo, walima emakhaya.
UDudu utshala phezu kwesakhiwo na?
Kunjalo, utshala phezu kwesakhiwo.
UDudu uthatha amanzi emthonjeni na?
Kunjalo, uwathatha emthonjeni ngaphandle kwesakhiwo.
Izitshalo ziqinile na?
Kunjalo, ziqinile futhi zinhle.
UDudu uthengisa ukudla na?
Kunjalo, uthengisa ukudla kubantu besakhiwo.

lessons.title: Incwadi kaZoleka
lessons.summary: Writer Zoleka researches the old stories of Durban, checks every fact, rewrites her first part, finds a title and finishes the book at the end of the year.
lessons.text:
UZoleka ungumbhali. Uhlala eThekwini, futhi uthanda idolobha lakhe. Ufuna ukubhala incwadi ngezindaba zakudala zaseThekwini.

Kuqala uZoleka wenza ucwaningo. Uya ezindaweni ezindala zedolobha. Ukhuluma nabantu abadala. Ubhala phansi izindaba zabo. Ucwaningo lwakhe luthatha izinyanga eziningi.

UZoleka ugxila emsebenzini wakhe. Akenzi omunye umsebenzi. Uqinisa yonke into: ubuza abantu abaningi into eyodwa. Uthi: "Umbhali omuhle uqinisa izindaba zakhe. Kumele agxile emsebenzini wakhe."

Ngolunye usuku indoda endala ithi kuZoleka: "Le ndaba ayiyona iqiniso." UZoleka ubuza abanye abantu. Ngempela, le ndaba ayiyona iqiniso. UZoleka uyayiyeka.

Bese uZoleka uqala ukubhala. Ubhala ingxenye yokuqala yencwadi. Kodwa akayithandi. Uyayiguqula. Ubhala kabusha. Bese uyayiguqula futhi, ubhala kabusha.

Incwadi idinga isihloko. UZoleka ucabanga isikhathi eside. Ekugcineni uthola isihloko: "Idolobha Lethu Elidala." Uthi: "Lesi sihloko sihle."

Ekupheleni konyaka incwadi iphelele. Zonke izingxenye zikhona. Ekupheleni kwencwadi uZoleka uphetha ngala magama: "Abantu bayaguqula idolobha, kodwa izindaba zalo zihlala nathi."

UZoleka unika umama wakhe incwadi. Umama uyayifunda. Uthi: "Le ncwadi iphelele, Zoleka. Uyiphetha kahle."

Imibuzo:
UZoleka ungumbhali na?
Kunjalo, ungumbhali eThekwini.
UZoleka wenza ucwaningo na?
Kunjalo, wenza ucwaningo izinyanga eziningi.
UZoleka uguqula ingxenye yokuqala na?
Kunjalo, uyayiguqula, ubhala kabusha.
Isihloko sencwadi sithini?
Isihloko sithi: "Idolobha Lethu Elidala."
Incwadi iphelele ekupheleni konyaka na?
Kunjalo, iphelele ekupheleni konyaka.
UZoleka uphetha incwadi yakhe ngamagama amahle na?
Kunjalo, uyiphetha ngamagama amahle.

lessons.title: Izilwane zasePitoli
lessons.summary: Zinzi is hired at the Pretoria zoo; she rises early to feed and water the animals, notices a small flying animal that cannot fly, and after five days of medicine it flies again.
lessons.text:
UZinzi uhlala ePitoli. Indawo yezilwane yasePitoli iyamqasha. Lo msebenzi musha kuye, futhi uyawuthanda kakhulu. Uthi: "Ngiyawuthanda lo msebenzi. Kuhle ukuthi bangiqashile."

Nsuku zonke uZinzi uvuka ekuseni kakhulu. Uya ezilwaneni. Izilwane nazo ziyavuka.

Kuqala uZinzi unika izilwane ezinkulu ezinhlanu inyama. Izilwane lezi zidla inyama kuphela. Bese unika izilwane ezincane ukudla kwazo. Zonke izilwane ziyaphuza amanzi. UZinzi uthela amanzi amasha njalo, ukuze ziphuze amanzi amahle.

Kukhona izilwane ezincane ezindizayo. Ziyandiza phezulu usuku lonke. Esinye isilwane esincane sithanda ibhola. Sidlala ngebhola usuku lonke. Ngezinye izinsuku izingane zesikole ziyeza. Zibuka izilwane, futhi uZinzi uzitshela ngazo.

Indoda endala esebenza lapho ithi kuZinzi: "Nxa isilwane sinenkinga, ngitshele ngokushesha. Nxa isilwane singadli, ngitshele futhi."

Ngolunye usuku uZinzi ubona isilwane esincane esingandizi. Asiphuzi namanzi. UZinzi utshela indoda endala. Indoda ibheka isilwane. Ithi: "Unyawo lwaso lunenkinga." Basinika umuthi.

Ngemuva kwezinsuku ezinhlanu isilwane esincane siyaphuza futhi. Bese siyandiza futhi! UZinzi uthi: "Namuhla ngiyabona ukuthi lo msebenzi muhle kakhulu."

Imibuzo:
Indawo yezilwane iqasha uZinzi na?
Kunjalo, iyamqasha.
UZinzi uvuka ekuseni kakhulu na?
Kunjalo, uvuka ekuseni kakhulu nsuku zonke.
Izilwane ezinkulu zidla inyama na?
Kunjalo, zidla inyama kuphela.
Isilwane esincane siyandiza ekuqaleni na?
Cha, asindizi.
Isilwane siyandiza futhi na?
Kunjalo, ngemuva kwezinsuku ezinhlanu siyandiza futhi.
